summary: Former lookout in Bayfield County, WI, listed as gone with no register number; a 1947 topographic map reproduction shows it. No build, staffing or removal record found.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association. No source we read describes what, if anything, remains at the site.

notes_for_editor: Thin record, below the 120-word floor because nothing more is supported. Two web searches and about six reads found no build date, designer, staffing, removal or present-day site record. The 1947 mention rests on a Pastmaps catalogue page describing a reproduction of a topographic map, not on the sheet itself. Access is unknown and omitted from facts. The OpenStreetMap elevation (408 m) is not used. The brief's record needs no corrections.
